description: User accounts for the Platypus Health demo tenant on the aucore node. Create with: python scripts/manage_smart_users.py --bulk --users-file module-config/platypus-users.json --node aucore
notes: Passwords are NOT stored here. Every account below already exists on aucore; the script is idempotent and skips an existing account rather than resetting its password. The live passwords are in AWS Secrets Manager under smilecdr-user-passwords, keys smilecdr-<username>-password (smilecdr-platypus-demo-patient-password, smilecdr-platypus-expo-patient-password, smilecdr-platypus-expo-other-password), alongside the admin and devtester passwords. They are not recoverable from the server, only resettable, so keep those entries current. On a fresh node the script generates a password and prints it once (or writes it with --credentials-file), which must then be stored there. See docs/platypus-demo-tenant.md.
